about: J.T. O'Sullivan's (The QB School, YouTube) per-snap claims for five 2026 single-QB game breakdowns, paraphrased by Claude from the videos' original English auto-captions (en-orig) on Oct 20 2026, before any coach run. Third-party footage, for private testing only. from/to: the snap's clean first play-through in the downloaded breakdown video (seconds), cut by frame signals and checked by eye at every boundary: no studio, no pen ink, no rewind. Overlays that remain: noted per snap. jt_at: where in the breakdown he introduces the snap. verdict: good, bad, mixed (good play with a fault he names), or not_on_qb (he says the quarterback had no real chance). faults: the quarterback faults he names on that snap, as tags from fault_tags. outcome_sure false (added Oct 20 after the first coach run, from frames, before scoring the second): JT doesn't say the result and the film doesn't settle it, so record accuracy leaves that snap out.

fault_tags.late: hesitates, holds the ball, double clutches, throws late
fault_tags.inaccurate: the throw misses: high, low (sinker), behind, sailed, or a missed open receiver
fault_tags.footwork: base or drop: feet narrow or together, hitching backward, shuffle drop, coming out flat
fault_tags.movement: leaves a clean pocket or moves off-platform when he didn't need to
fault_tags.read: a misread: the wrong side first, a conflict defender, a backside read he didn't get to
fault_tags.risk: a low-percentage choice over a safer answer

scoring.habit: match: the coach's habit names a fault tag that JT names on 2 or more snaps of that video (its themes). partial: same family (a miss in general for a footwork theme). miss: a fault JT names on no snap, or on one snap only. contradicted: blames the quarterback for snaps JT calls not_on_qb, or names a fault JT calls a strength. For Purdy JT names no habit: the right answer is no single habit (found false), and any habit is a false positive.
scoring.evidence: each moment the coach cites, mapped to a snap by reel time: supported when JT's verdict for that snap is bad or mixed with a fault in the coach's habit; contradicted when JT calls the snap good or not_on_qb; unrelated otherwise.
scoring.record: per snap, the coach's events in it: right when the outcome it records matches JT's (completion, incompletion, interception, sack, fumble, run, touchdown); counted only where the coach recorded something.
scoring.false_claims: statements in the coach's verdict or cited moments that the frames or JT's account contradict, each listed.
